The '''November 2014 Twin Cities tournament''' was a local tournament on 23 November 2014 at Legion Games, 3128 West Hwy 13, Burnsville, Minnesota, organized by [[Mark Walseth]], the day after a demonstration at the same store. Twenty-six players entered, and a new local player, Kate, was in a three-way tie for first.<ref name="tc14">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=921575#p921575 Twin Cities, MN], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 November 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122220957/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p921575.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="tc-ann" /><ref name="tc-org" />

== Format ==

* '''Saturday, 22 November:''' demonstration, 1:00–3:00. Sixteen current players volunteered, and nine new players attended (eight had never played, and one was returning).<ref name="tc-ann" /><ref name="tc-sat">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=921485#p921485 Twin Cities, MN], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 November 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122220957/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p921575.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Sunday, 23 November:''' a free four-game tournament, 1:00–5:00, using differential. The 26 players were split into a beginner bracket of 6, an intermediate bracket of 10, and an advanced bracket of 10, and played inside their bracket. One more player sat out so the field would have no bye.<ref name="tc-ann" /><ref name="tc14" />
* '''Sunday card pool:''' Reset cards (the new Virtual Sets 0 and 1) and Decipher cards<ref name="tc-pool">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=920969#p920969 Twin Cities, MN], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 November 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122220957/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p921575.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Sunday field:''' 18 Minnesota veterans, 6 players new from the Saturday demonstration, and 2 players who had retired in 2002<ref name="tc14" />
